claim: In the August 2026 announcement, the excavation project lead described the Abhayagiri bronze discovery as the most significant find within the protected zone in more than thirty years.
bounded_by: This records an interested project lead's assessment reported by AFP; it is not an independently verified ranking of discoveries and should remain explicitly attributed.
notes: Disposition for GF-ABH-02 in Run27: promoted only as an attributed source fact, not as an objective superlative.
